title: Two-step sign-in
off: Signing in also needs a code from an app on your phone, so someone who knows your password still can't sign in.
passwordStep: Enter your password to confirm it's you.
setupWrongCode: That code doesn't match. Enter the code the app shows now.
scanStep: Scan this QR code with an authenticator app such as Google Authenticator, then enter the app's 6-digit code.
qrAlt: QR code for your authenticator app
secret: Can't scan? Type this key instead
codesWarning: Keep these somewhere safe now: they won't be shown again. If you lose your phone, each one signs you in once.
copyFailed: Couldn't copy. Please write the codes down.
newCodesStep: Your old recovery codes will stop working. Enter a code from the app to confirm.
offStep: To turn it off, enter your password and a code from the app, or a recovery code.
offDone: Two-step sign-in has been turned off.
